name: Mariana County
lede: Where the story starts: Key Lento, home in Chapter 1, plus Watson Bay, Capri, Belpoint, Corsair Key and the part of Grassrivers that falls inside the county. Do the Chapter 1 items first, because they're gone once the chapter ends.

name: Kelly County
lede: Port Gellhorn and the Starlet Motel, where Chapter 2 is set, and the country round it: Buckskin Swamp, Manifest Canyon, Emerald Springs, Ambrosia and more. The motel items go when Chapter 2 ends.

name: Lummox County
lede: Mount Kalaga, Moreau, Grayson, Bonanza and Tallaloko. Bret's hunts bring Jason here from Chapter 2.

name: Vice City
lede: The city itself, open from Chapter 3: Downtown, Little Cuba, La Perle, Crosstown, Tequesta and the rest. Grab the Bayside apartment items before Chapter 3 ends.

name: Vice Beach
lede: Ocean Beach, Washington Beach and Dalton Island, open from Chapter 3.

name: Vice-Dale County
lede: Southside, Hamlet, Vespucci Island and the airport.

name: Leonard County
lede: Belville, where Andy's jobs take Lucia in Chapter 3, and Waning Sands on the coast.
